title: convolvulus lilacinus
intro: Convolvulus lilacinus, commonly known as morning glory, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep, and providing relief from anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Convolvulus lilacinus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant make it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions, and further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
